name: PalmPilotz
summary: Fast paced VR game that blends music, arcade action and skill into an exhilarating experience! Take control of a tiny spaceship with the power of your hands as you navigate through intense asteroid fields, battle alien ships, collect power-ups and more. The real magic happens with our custom music player, where dynamic music effects sync seamlessly with your gameplay, creating a one-of-a-kind audio-visual adventure.
